- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Restore Banner: Add a prominent callout on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets will instantly reappear after authenticating. (why: The top support complaint (8 emails) is about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Spawn Live Status Stream: Show dynamic step-by-step progress status messages during the waiting screen while rendering and spawning the desktop pet. (why: The waiting screen has an extremely high mean time of 2336 seconds and users report pets not appearing on their desktop.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Desktop Companion Path Layout: Switch choose_path screen layout to spotlight mode with high-emphasis selection cards. (why: Conversion on choose_path is 83.8% with median 8s but high mean time (514s), indicating user hesitation.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery Safety Assurance Copy: Update headline and body on sign_in screen to explicitly assure account data integrity and pet preservation. (why: Multiple support emails (8 tickets) mention fear of missing or reset pets upon signing in.)
4: [finish, redesign] Stage-Based Desktop Home Welcome Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout with pet interaction shortcut key prompts. (why: Finish step drops off to 68.7% with median 395s / mean 5815s and users suffer post-onboarding confusion.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Visibility Sound Alert Notification: Add audio and visual notification alert toggle on the waiting screen when desktop rendering completes. (why: Users wait median 201s / mean 2336s on waiting screen, leading to missed pet appearances or app stalls.)
